doc.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001

title: Marrying young and going on the road at $17 a week
summary: Bert married his girlfriend of five years so she could be with him; road travel at 18.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: So by this time you’d pretty much decided this is what I’m going to do.

No, in other words, I liked to play and that was it. In fact, I was making $17 a week with that band and I was going with this girl from when I was 13 we met, only 13. And I said, “we can get married now.” So we did. Because I had to go on the road and I wasn’t going to leave her, so $17 a week was a lot then.
Oh my. You could send some money home, huh?
Wow. What was it like being on the road? How old were you? You were 18?
